purpose: Acknowledge that a changed condition brings its own issues or response.
keywords: Vたら + same Vたで; adjective conditional + repeated adjective + で
If I buy a car, owning it will bring maintenance costs.
If people do come, then we will lack space.
If it is cheap, then I worry about the quality.
formation: Vたら + same Vたで; adjective conditional + repeated adjective + で
restrictions: Often contrasts the problems of having something with those of lacking it.
mistake: Repeat the relevant condition; it is not a simple single たら conditional.
